heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Do you use Unity for iOS games?
items.answer: Usually yes, because it supports many platforms. We also use native tools when they suit the game.

items.question: Can the game also run on Android?
items.answer: Yes. A Unity project can ship to both platforms with little extra work.

items.question: How do you handle monetization?
items.answer: We integrate ads and in-app purchases designed around gameplay.

items.question: How long does ios game development take?
items.answer: A simple casual game takes about 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game usually takes 6 months or more.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
